Nadia (Security): Legal requested we preserve auth+proxy logs for a specific investigation. Default retention is 30d; they want 180d for just the affected set. Can we scope this without changing global retention?
Owen (SRE): Yes. Copy matched objects to s3://redwood-hold/LegalHold-2026-08-01/, enable Object Lock (GOVERNANCE), use a dedicated CMK.
Tan (Infra): Important: do not widen the SIEM export principal. Instead create a one-off export job with a narrow query that writes to the hold path. Add bucket policy to allow only that export principal PutObject to the hold prefix.
Priya (Legal): Tag must be LegalHold-2026-08-01 and include case=CASE-981. We need a scrubbed copy (PII redacted) before granting read. Also require a manifest with SHA256s and simple chain-of-custody notes.
Nadia (Security): Proposed ephemeral role: role/ephemeral_legal_reader_CASE981 with s3:GetObject on redwood-hold/LegalHold-2026-08-01/*, CloudTrail read. TTL=180d, assume-role with external_id=CASE-981 and require session tags reason=LegalHold-2026-08-01 ticket=SEC-981.
Tan (Infra): I'll prepare Terraform for the role, trust policy, KMS grant scoped to the hold CMK and set grant expiration at 180d. We'll log all AssumeRole events.
Owen (SRE): Playbook snippet:
1) run SIEM export query limited by time/index into redwood-hold/LegalHold-2026-08-01/
2) set object lock and attach metadata: legal_hold_id=LegalHold-2026-08-01, case=CASE-981, origin=incident-981
3) run scrub pipeline to produce /scrubbed/ copies; generate custody-manifest.json with file hashes
4) deny DeleteObject except infra-admins, deny PutObjectAcl
SysBot: [automated] referenced playbook: /playbooks/log-preservation. Template tasks created: create_hold -> scoped_export -> set_lock -> run_scrub -> attach_manifest -> create_ephemeral_role.
Priya (Legal): Legal will only approve access after scrubbed copies + manifest are attached. Please include scrub sample for review.
Nadia (Security): Action items: Tan TF + KMS grant, Owen export + scrub + manifest, Priya review redaction. I'll file SEC-981 and link this thread. :thumbsup:
